children: UBS initiated coverage on several colocation data center stocks with a very positive view as AI computing power remains constrained versus developer demand.
all received Buy ratings from the financial services firm.

"Time to power remains the gating factor in scaling compute, and their cryptominer legacies with favorable grid access have already translated into ~5GW of leased capacity (~$125B in contracted revs), with expansion opportunities for an additional ~12GW," said UBS analysts, led by Ryan Gravett, in an investor report. "Power pipelines provide an enviable position with AI infrastructure requirements set to triple to UBSe ~260GW of new data center capacity globally from '28-30E. We forecast ~80% annual EBITDA growth on average across our coverage from '27-29E (~10% above Street in '29E) while shares trade at 12-18x 2028E EBITDA, largely reflecting already contracted assets."
UBS set a $143 price target on Hut 8 due to its sizable pipeline, value creation and high-quality tenants. The company has an estimated 2.8GW IT pipeline.

TeraWulf received a $24 price target as the company has demonstrated the ability to convert brownfield industrial sites into data centers near high-population areas. However, the public pushback on data centers creates potential risks.
Applied Digital was assigned a $38 price target, as it already has a 1.3GW backlog, and tenants have expansion options at existing data center sites.

UBS set a $24 target on Core Scientific as it provides upside potential from earnings revisions and multiple expansion from capacity deliveries. The company also benefits from a significant deal with AMD
Finally, Cipher Digital received a $23 price target.

"Shares trade at a ~30% premium to contracted asset value, but we believe this discounts near-term leasing opportunities that could increase contracted capacity by ~70% and support our outlook for ~$850M of EBITDA in 2028E," UBS analysts noted. "High concentration in Texas (~95% of portfolio) adds risk, but recent disclosure on Batch Zero classifications of Cipher's longer-dated pipeline (that could ~6x the platform over time) is a positive step in lowering the uncertainty risk premium in shares, in our view."

title: UBS provides bullish initiation to colocation stocks as data center capacity prepares to triple
